Open Source Philosophy 🌟

I believe the best software is software you can read. Every project I build is designed to be inspectable, forkable, and improvable. If you can't understand how it works, it's not done yet.

Interested in collaborating? Check my Now page to see what I'm currently working on, or find me on GitHub.
